svg.title: Uilleann chanter, Craig Fischer's square bore in strips, sheet 1 of 1
svg.desc: 1 user unit = 1mm. Uilleann chanter, Craig Fischer's square bore in strips, sheet 1 of 1. 3mm ply, drawn for a 0.13mm kerf. Engraves first: blue #0000ff marks the greyscale image engraves, Fischer's four bore dishes in the lid's bore layer, Grayscale mode in xTool Creative Space, black 1.5mm deep, set on scrap of this sheet; burn shallow rather than deep. Then orange #ff8000 cuts the seats, finger and pin holes first; then black #000000 frees the plates.
